about: CHA-only dispatch edges on in-module interfaces in golang/crypto 0ae6809b (linux/amd64), adjudicated by reading the code before the draw. First matching rule wins; `sites` are files or file:line ('*' = any); `types` lists several receivers; `callers` restricts a rule to callers (a trailing '*' is a prefix), needed for wrapper bodies, whose sites are all ':0'. Every CHA-only edge of the linux dump must match a rule (goldmodel.load require_all). Promoted-wrapper receivers are spelled (*pkg/x.T) / (pkg/x.T). x/crypto is a library, so a value reaches a site when module code puts it there (VTA sees that, and VTA is sound for flows inside the module) OR when a caller of the exported API can: by passing a value it obtained from the API, or one of its own implementations of an exported interface returning such a value, without reflect or unsafe. A CHA-only edge is therefore accepted only when the site's value comes from such a caller and the caller can hold a value of that type; an unexported type the module only ever creates by value can never be a pointer, and vice versa.

rules.reason: Manager.Cache is an exported field (acme/autocert/autocert.go:118); DirCache is an exported string type with value methods (acme/autocert/cache.go:39-97), so a caller can set Cache to &d. Gold-neutral: the wrapper only forwards to DirCache's methods, which VTA already gives these sites
pbDecrypt's info is a *encryptedPrivateKeyInfo (pkcs12/safebags.go:26-31) or an encryptedContentInfo value (pkcs12/pkcs12.go:349); decryptable is unexported, so no caller supplies one
cipherType is only ever shaWithTripleDESCBC{} or shaWith40BitRC2CBC{} by value (pkcs12/crypto.go:71,73)
keyDBLine.matcher is a hashedHost or a hostPatterns slice value (ssh/knownhosts/knownhosts.go:259-261, 273-307); a single hostPattern is only an element of that slice, and matcher is unexported

connectionState's embedded packetCipher is set only from the cipher constructors and the pendingKeyChange channel they feed (ssh/transport.go:152,203,220; ssh/cipher.go); a connectionState is never itself stored as a packetCipher, and the interface is unexported

packetConn is unexported, so every value is module-made and VTA sees it: kex runs over handshakeTransport.conn, the raw *transport (ssh/handshake.go), while auth, mux and channel writes run over the handshake or control-proxy transport (ssh/client_auth.go, ssh/mux.go)

no exported function takes a Channel; every Channel in the module comes from OpenChannel or NewChannel.Accept, which return *channel; chanConn wraps those (ssh/tcpip.go dial, ssh/streamlocal.go) and is handed out only as a net.Conn

*channel is the only NewChannel the module creates (ssh/mux.go:333 m.incomingChannels <- c); NewClientConn returns that Go channel (ssh/client.go:88) and the caller or Dial hands it to NewClient (ssh/client.go:53), whose handleChannelOpens and HandleChannelOpen feed every listed site
ServeAgent(agent Agent, c) is exported (ssh/agent/server.go); a caller gets a *keyring from NewKeyring and a *client from NewClient and may serve either
as for Agent: s.agent is the caller's agent, and both *client and *keyring implement ExtendedAgent (ssh/agent/server.go:134,176 assert it)
passwordCallback and publicKeyCallback are unexported and created only by value (ssh/client_auth.go:229,235,487,493); no pointer to one exists

the only noneAuth is new(noneAuth) in clientAuthenticate's loop variable (ssh/client_auth.go:79); config.Auth (site :136) and retryableAuthMethod.authMethod (:689,:698) hold the caller's methods, and a caller cannot obtain a noneAuth

the AuthMethods here are the caller's: ClientConfig.Auth and AuthCallback's result (ssh/client_auth.go:80-136) and RetryableAuthMethod's argument (:712); Password, PublicKeys, KeyboardInteractive, GSSAPIWithMICAuthMethod and RetryableAuthMethod return these types, and KeyboardInteractiveChallenge is exported, so &challenge is legal too (gold-neutral: its wrapper forwards to the value method)
connection embeds sshConn by value (ssh/connection.go:105); a *sshConn is never converted to an interface, only reached through *connection's promoted methods

CertChecker.Authenticate is exported and is meant as ServerConfig.PublicKeyCallback (ssh/certs.go:385), which the server calls with its *connection (ssh/server.go); a caller may also call it with a *ServerConn or *Client, which embed Conn (gold-neutral: those wrappers dispatch on the embedded *connection)
ServerConn's embedded Conn is always the *connection NewServerConn builds (ssh/server.go:378)

these sites dispatch on Client.Conn, which is NewClient's exported Conn parameter (ssh/client.go:53-62); a caller may pass a *Client or *ServerConn, both of which implement Conn by embedding it. Gold-neutral: the wrappers dispatch on their own embedded Conn, which VTA already resolves to *connection

never a Signer value: algorithmSignerWrapper is unexported, made only by value and held only as an AlgorithmSigner (ssh/handshake.go:800 pickHostKey's result, ssh/client_auth.go:277 a multiAlgorithmSigner field); multiAlgorithmSigner and algorithmOpenSSHCertSigner exist only as pointers (ssh/keys.go:462, ssh/certs.go:285-292, ssh/client_auth.go:271,276,372)
SignCert's authority is the caller's Signer; :488 runs only when its public key is a certificate type (ssh/certs.go:486-489): a NewCertSigner result, or an agent signer whose key is a certificate
their public key comes from NewPublicKey and is never a certificate (ssh/keys.go:1232, dsaPrivateKey.PublicKey), so SignCert never reaches :488 with them
SignCert's authority is the caller's Signer; these can hold a non-certificate key and so pass the check at ssh/certs.go:486
a cert signer's public key is its *Certificate, whose type is a certificate type, so SignCert returns at ssh/certs.go:487 first
an agent signer is not a MultiAlgorithmSigner, and with a non-RSA key it skips the AlgorithmSigner branch, so SignCert falls through to authority.Sign (ssh/certs.go:497-514)
cert signers return at ssh/certs.go:487; multiAlgorithmSigner, dsaPrivateKey and wrappedSigner implement MultiAlgorithmSigner (ssh/keys.go:473,742,1249) and return from the first branch (:497-505)

the Signer is the caller's: NewCertSigner's signer (ssh/certs.go:278, kept as openSSHCertSigner.signer at :287-294) and SignCert's authority (:479); NewSignerFromKey, NewCertSigner, NewSignerWithAlgorithms and agent's Signers (ssh/agent/client.go:827) return each of these types

these signers are built inside the module from a raw private key: NewSignerFromKey(s) (ssh/agent/client.go:799) and NewSignerFromKey plus NewCertSigner (ssh/agent/keyring.go:168-175), never an agent signer, and in insertCert never a cert signer

the value is the caller's Signer asserted to MultiAlgorithmSigner (NewCertSigner's signer, ssh/certs.go:283; SignCert's authority with a non-certificate key, :492); NewSignerWithAlgorithms and NewSignerFromKey return these types
no *algorithmSignerWrapper is ever made: it is created only by value (ssh/handshake.go:800, ssh/client_auth.go:277)

an algorithmSignerWrapper exists only as pickHostKey's result (passed to kex.Server) and as a multiAlgorithmSigner field built in pickSignatureAlgorithm (ssh/client_auth.go:277); it never reaches a host key list, a keyring, a cert signer, SignCert or NewSignerWithAlgorithms, and a caller cannot obtain one

algorithmOpenSSHCertSigner.algorithmSigner is NewCertSigner's caller-supplied signer (ssh/certs.go:283-292): an agent signer takes the AlgorithmSigner case, a NewSignerWithAlgorithms result the MultiAlgorithmSigner case
SignCert's authority as an AlgorithmSigner that is not a MultiAlgorithmSigner (ssh/certs.go:503): an agent signer, with an RSA key for :506
cert signers return at ssh/certs.go:487; multiAlgorithmSigner, dsaPrivateKey and wrappedSigner are MultiAlgorithmSigners and return from the branch at :497

NewSignerWithAlgorithms's signer is the caller's AlgorithmSigner (ssh/keys.go:442), and :447 handles a *multiAlgorithmSigner explicitly; NewCertSigner, NewSignerWithAlgorithms, NewSignerFromKey and agent's Signers return these types
a keyring's signers come from NewSignerFromKey and NewCertSigner over a raw private key (ssh/agent/keyring.go:168-175), never from an agent
ed25519PublicKey is unexported and made only by value (ssh/keys.go:813,1330); no pointer to one exists

the key is the caller's: the key argument of the agent's Remove and SignWithFlags, FingerprintLegacyMD5/SHA256, MarshalAuthorizedKey, knownhosts.Line, FixedHostKey and a host-key callback the caller may invoke, or the exported Key/SignatureKey fields of a Certificate; ParsePublicKey yields every listed ssh type and agent List yields *agent.Key

the key is PublicKey() of a caller-supplied Signer (client auth signers, server host keys, SignCert's authority, NewSignerWithAlgorithms's signer); Signer is exported, and a caller's own implementation (a hardware security key, say) may return a parsed sk key

the key here is made inside the module and VTA has every type it can be: parsed from the wire or a file (agent server's parse*Cert, ParseKnownHosts, ParseAuthorizedKey, knownhosts parseLine, serverAuthenticate, verifyHostKeySignature), the pubKey NewSignerFromSigner computes (wrappedSigner, ssh/keys.go:1232), dsaPrivateKey's own key, an agentKeyringSigner's *agent.Key (ssh/agent/client.go:827), a keyring signer's key (ssh/agent/keyring.go:168-175, never sk), or SignCert's :488, reached only by certificate keys
